10 Description: According to a survey conducted in 2024 in Japan, the majority of businesses that either engaged or were considering engaging in e-commerce were selling in the domestic and overseas markets. Over 66 percent were distributing or planning to distribute
their products overseas, the preferred method was through cross-border e-commerce by selling from Japan to international customers. Read more
Note(s): Japan; November 6 to December 6, 2024; 1,796 firms; businesses using or considering using e-commerce; multiple answers allowed
Source(s): JETRO

Description: According to a survey conducted in 2024 in Japan, around two in five businesses were selling over e-commerce channels. While over 25 percent of responding firms intended to expand the dimension of their e-commerce business, 37.4 percent had no
plans to implement online sales in their distributions. Read more
Note(s): Japan; November 6 to December 6, 2024; 3,162 firms; including firms selling domestically and/or overseas
Source(s): JETRO

grown steadily in size in the last decade, offline retail remained the main sales channel. Read more
Note(s): Japan; 2015 to 2024
Source(s): METI (Japan)

auctions and flea market platforms carrying the market growth. Read more
Note(s): Japan; fiscal years 2016 to 2024; the Japanese fiscal year runs from April 1 of the stated year to March 31 of the following year; market size based on transaction value
